Description: APK-link scam message classified as prize_lottery instead of remote_access
Reproduction Steps: Send text: 'Download the SBI Reward app apk from http://sbi-rewards-claim.cfd/app.apk to redeem your reward points today.' and call analyze_text with use_ml=False
Expected Behavior: scam_type should be remote_access since the message contains an APK download link
Actual Behavior: scam_type is prize_lottery because (1) URL masking removes the .apk from the text before pattern matching so the remote_access indicator never fires; (2) reward_bait fires on 'reward points' in the remaining text; (3) reward_bait playbook priority is lower than remote_access but remote_access indicator never triggers
Root Cause: URL masking in _mask_urls() blanks the entire URL including path. The .apk regex in lexicon.py matches URL paths but _mask_urls() runs before indicator matching. The pattern \.apk\b\" in remote_access patterns is designed for text mentions of APK but cannot fire when the .apk is embedded in a URL. The URL analyzer correctly flags apk_link but this does not feed into playbook selection."
Suggested Resolution: Two options: (1) Extract APK flag from URL analysis into indicator-equivalent weight for playbook selection; (2) Pre-scan for .apk in URL path before masking and add a synthetic remote_access indicator. Preferred: check URL flags for apk_link in pick_playbook() before or alongside indicator check. Do not modify without authorization.

Description: /api/v1/playbooks/{id} returns HTTP 200 with error body for unknown IDs instead of HTTP 404
Expected Behavior: HTTP 404 response per REST semantics for not-found resources
Actual Behavior: HTTP 200 response with body {'error': 'Playbook not found'}
Root Cause: The endpoint uses a conditional return inside an HTTP 200 handler. API_CONTRACT.md explicitly documents this as by-design for now. However standard REST practice and consumer expectations are for 404.
Suggested Resolution: Change the handler to: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Playbook not found') when playbook_id not in PLAYBOOK_DETAILS. Additive change, non-breaking for consumers who check body already.

Reproduction Steps: Run any pytest test using FastAPI TestClient
Actual Behavior: WARNING: Using httpx with starlette.testclient is deprecated; install httpx2 instead
Root Cause: fastapi 0.165.0 TestClient uses httpx which is now deprecated in favour of httpx2 in Starlette/FastAPI test infrastructure
Suggested Resolution: Add httpx2 to requirements-dev.txt and update imports. Run: pip install httpx2
